description: This file contains functions for retrieving and processing transaction lists related to contacts and documents in the ERPNext system, including web form contexts, transaction filtering, and permissions.

methods.name: get_list_context
methods.description: Provides context data for listing transactions, including formatting and currency info.

methods.name: get_webform_list_context
methods.description: Returns a context with a get_list method for webforms if the module is 'erpnext'.

methods.name: get_webform_transaction_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for custom doctypes, applying filters based on linked documents.

methods.name: get_transaction_list
methods.description: Fetches a filtered list of transactions, considering user permissions and document status.

methods.name: get_list_for_transactions
methods.description: Gets a list of transactions like invoices or orders, with optional text search and filters.

methods.name: rfq_transaction_list
methods.description: Retrieves RFQ-related transactions filtered by supplier and document status.

methods.name: post_process
methods.description: Enhances transaction data with status and item previews, and sets indicators.

methods.name: get_customers_suppliers
methods.description: Determines customers and suppliers linked to a user based on roles and permissions.

methods.name: has_website_permission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to view a specific document based on customer or supplier links.

methods.name: get_customer_filter
methods.description: Creates filters for documents based on associated customers or suppliers.

methods.name: get_customer_field_name
methods.description: Returns the appropriate customer field name for a given doctype.
